{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Filter for the treatment group
treatment_group = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Calculate the change in biomarker level (final - baseline)
treatment_group['change'] = treatment_group['biomarker_final'] - treatment_group['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean change and print it
mean_change = treatment_group['change'].mean()
print(mean_change)"}
